For [expression](/docs/shell/commands/categories/expression/).

<div class='command-title'>Select columns by their index position. Supports negative indices (e.g., -1 for the last column).</div>

> **warning This command requires a plugin**
> The `polars selector by-index` command resides in the `polars` plugin.
> To use this command, you must install and register `nu_plugin_polars`.
> See the [Plugins](/docs/shell/book/plugins/) chapter in the book for more information.



## Command Type

`plugin`

## Signature

```> polars selector by-index {flags} ...rest```

## Flags

 -  `--not-strict`: Allow out-of-range indices without error.

## Parameters

 -  `...rest`: Column index positions to select (negative indices count from the end).


## Input/output types:

| input | output          |
| ----- | --------------- |
| any   | polars_selector |
## Examples

Select first and third columns by index
```nu
> [[a b c]; [1 2 3] [4 5 6]]
    | polars into-df
    | polars select (polars selector by-index 0 2)
    | polars collect
╭───┬───┬───╮
│ # │ a │ c │
├───┼───┼───┤
│ 0 │ 1 │ 3 │
│ 1 │ 4 │ 6 │
╰───┴───┴───╯

```

Select the last column using a negative index
```nu
> [[a b c]; [1 2 3] [4 5 6]]
    | polars into-df
    | polars select (polars selector by-index -1)
    | polars collect
╭───┬───╮
│ # │ c │
├───┼───┤
│ 0 │ 3 │
│ 1 │ 6 │
╰───┴───╯

```
